key_sections_summary: Start 1 mcg/d (0.5 elderly); maintenance 0.25–2 mcg/d; HD intermittent 0.5–2 mcg after each session; conversion ×7/3 or ×7/2; children >20 kg 1 mcg, <20 kg 0.05 mcg/kg; CI hypercalcemia; t1/2 calcitriol 35 h.
note: Our paraphrase of the regulator product information; numbers copied exactly. Not rendered as text.
